vendor: Paperspace, dba DigitalOcean (legal entity: DigitalOcean, LLC / DigitalOcean Holdings, Inc.)
product_family: Cloud GPU / compute platform for AI/ML: Notebooks (development), Machines (training), and Deployments (model-to-API). Acquired by DigitalOcean in July 2023; by 2026 the Paperspace brand and paperspace.com have been folded into DigitalOcean's product line ('GPU Droplets' / 'Paperspace' business unit), with the site footer reading 'Paperspace dba DigitalOcean'.

No paperspace.com or DigitalOcean page offers a signed Business Associate Agreement (BAA) for the Paperspace/GPU product line specifically.

privacy.ai_training_note: Paperspace is an IaaS/GPU-compute and notebook platform, not itself a hosted model that trains on customer prompts by default. Neither the Paperspace privacy policy nor DigitalOcean's DPA/GDPR pages make any statement about training AI/ML models on customer content; DigitalOcean's DPA states 'DigitalOcean does not and will not access or use Customer Content except as necessary to maintain or provide the Services, or as may be necessary to comply with the law or a binding order of a governmental body.' No explicit opt-out toggle for AI training was found, because no AI-training-on-customer-data claim exists to opt out of. Customer notebook, model code, and training data on the platform are not represented anywhere as being used to train DigitalOcean's or a third party's models.
privacy.data_region: Not specified with certainty for the Paperspace product specifically; DigitalOcean operates data centers in North America, Europe (Amsterdam, Frankfurt, London), and Asia-Pacific (Singapore, Bangalore, Sydney), per the ISO 27001 facility list. Cross-border transfer to the U.S. is explicitly contemplated in the Paperspace privacy policy.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: All Paperspace traffic is secured over SSL/TLS across web, desktop, and mobile; internal traffic (DB, web servers, API) is also SSL/TLS encrypted per the legacy Paperspace security page.

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: Databases secured with 256-bit AES or higher, per the legacy Paperspace security page (unverified independently; no named audit report).

security.name: 24/7 monitoring
security.value: Paperspace states a cloud operations team monitors security 24/7/365 (legacy page, no third-party attestation referenced).

security.name: Corporate SOC 2 / ISO 27001 program
security.value: Parent company DigitalOcean maintains SOC 2 Type II / SOC 3 Type II (auditor: Schellman & Company), ISO 27001 across its data center fleet, PCI-DSS SAQ-A, and CSA STAR Level 1.

products.name: Paperspace Notebooks
products.data_scope: User code, datasets, and model artifacts uploaded/created within the notebook workspace.
products.notes: Now offered as a DigitalOcean product; billed and administered through DigitalOcean accounts.

products.name: Paperspace Machines / GPU Droplets
products.data_scope: Whatever workloads/data the customer runs on the provisioned GPU/CPU instance; DigitalOcean does not access Customer Content except as necessary to operate the service.
products.notes: Core infrastructure is now integrated into DigitalOcean's broader compute fleet (per ISO 27001 facility list).

products.name: Paperspace Deployments
products.data_scope: Model weights and inference request/response payloads routed through customer-deployed endpoints.
products.notes: No separate compliance documentation found specific to this sub-product; inherits DigitalOcean's platform-level certifications.

compare.pricing_model: Usage-based / per-second GPU billing, on-demand, no long-term commitment required (per home page copy: 'Low-cost GPUs with per-second billing', 'No commitments').
compare.data_residency: Multi-region (NA, EU, APAC) via DigitalOcean's global data center footprint; no per-product data residency guarantee found for Paperspace specifically.

flags: Paperspace is no longer an independent legal entity for compliance purposes. The paperspace.com homepage is now DigitalOcean-branded, and the footer reads 'Paperspace dba DigitalOcean.' The certifications listed above are DigitalOcean's corporate certifications, not a separately audited Paperspace report.

The legacy paperspace.com/security page still carries old copy claiming 'data centers that have been accredited under ISO 27001, SOC 1 and SOC 2/SSAE 16/ISAE 3402 (Previously SAS 70 Type II), PCI Level 1, FISMA Moderate, Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX).' This describes the accreditation of the physical colocation facility, and separately names AWS for 'auxiliary services,' not an independent audit of Paperspace the company. The page appears to be unmaintained pre-acquisition (circa 2016-2017) marketing copy; the FISMA Moderate and SOX claims in particular have no current corroboration anywhere on digitalocean.com.

DigitalOcean's trust page says only that it offers 'eligibility to process HIPAA... workloads,' which is short of a formal HIPAA certification or a documented BAA process for the Paperspace product line.

No AI-training-on-customer-data disclosure was found anywhere (privacy policy, DPA, or trust pages), despite Paperspace/DigitalOcean actively marketing AI/ML fine-tuning workloads. This is a documentation gap, not a positive assurance of no training.
No ISO/IEC 42001 or CSA STAR AI (AI-governance-specific) evidence was found, which is unsurprising for a compute/IaaS vendor.
